summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_thread_loop, _thread_id) initialized in the constructor and set/cleared in the run entry point run_app inside try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 10 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src (the venv otherwise imports a separate base/ checkout). Pre-existing unrelated failures: 3 async tests in test_call_later.py and test_unmount.py fail because the venv lacks the asyncio pytest plugin. Nothing committed.
